question:
Study the given figure carefully and select the number that can replace the 'X'.

 
 

 5
 9
 13
 15
 
 

 14
 19
 24
 32
 
 

 9
 10
 11
 17
 
 

 32
 19
 X
 33
 
 

 23
 9
 6
 16
solution:
**The logic followed here is: **Column wise pattern is followed here.

1st column: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6788ed83a3a81f40d24a566029977a8f25af64d071982b24d041eb2bfd3944e5.png] 

→ (14 - 5) = 9

And,

 → (32 - 23) = 9 

2nd column: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbfc2c431e3395ddf95815eebc6e830ccd0edce58712631c31e235fa5fb86966.png] 

→ (19 - 9) = 10

And,

→ (19 - 9) = 10

4th column: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf647799bf1bd9c0f36474b6371e17c846949a18cff20269fb03f233796220f5.png] 

→ (32 - 15) = 17

And,

→ (33 - 16) = 17

Similarly,

3rd column: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86f0eb81257337e56376c265c2ee1c33e0e8f727f7aa463849a6f1cc72ee5950.png] 

→ (24 - 13) = 11

And,

→ (X - 6) = 11 → X = 11 + 6 → **X = 17**

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
